entries.reason: Event-loop DoS needs a source map with indexed section offsets to be parsed. The only runtime consumer is postcss via sanitize-html, which calls postcss.parse with { map: false } (node_modules/sanitize-html/index.js), so no source map is ever read from user input.

Vite dev server (launch-editor, Windows only). vite is a dev/build tool of the frontend and a devDependency of @pp/api; it is not in the API runtime image (docker/api/Dockerfile installs --omit=dev for @pp/api and bundles nothing of vite).
